fact: The national digital skills development plan for state agents 2026-2029, validated on 10 September 2026, targets all 183,502 state agents by 2029, after a Q1 2026 pilot with 583 agents from three ministries in which 70% of registrants did not sit the certification exams.
title: Le Sénégal adopte son plan de formation numérique des agents de l'État
